sentence: Nail the Frodoandalf. The spork can wait.

wombos.definition: A front two-and-a-half dive — a gymnastic or diving move that blends the small, committed energy of Frodo with the powerful, sweeping arc of Gandalf.
wombos.example: He stepped up to the board and launched into a clean Frodoandalf.

wombos.definition: A utensil that combines the bowl of a spoon with the tines of a fork, functioning as both simultaneously.
wombos.example: The school cafeteria only had sporks, so I used one for the whole meal.
